Subject: Urgent: Power & Network outage contingency for AcmeCorp Expo — booth B12

Morning team,

Vendor just pinged me: there's an intermittent transformer issue affecting the south hall power grid and the building team expects unstable voltage on the B aisle until they switch feeders later today. We go live with demos at 10:00 in booth B12.

Immediate asks:
- Can Venue Ops confirm whether booth B12 can be prioritized for a dedicated generator feed?
- Can we get onsite wireless APs or a temporary wired run to avoid relying on the building LAN?
- Oliver/Sofia: ETA for a carrier-level cellular failover (if you have bonded cellular rigs)?

If we can't get stable power/network, plan B is: run demo from battery-backed laptops + local recordings and switch live speaker to remote. Marcus, please prepare the recorded demo and a stripped-down local demo that runs without cloud connectivity.

Attachments: signed_sow_acme.pdf (contract), floorplan_v3.pdf (our booth location)

Ben
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0191

Date: 2026-03-09T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Power & Network outage contingency for AcmeCorp Expo — booth B12

Ben —

Thanks for the heads-up. Venue Ops has escalated to the electrical contractor; they're switching feeders at ~11:30 which should stabilize the south hall, but there is a risk of a short brownout during the switchover.

What we can do now:
- Reserve a portable generator for B12 (on standby) — ETA 09:45 for hookup.
- Bring two portable APs and one LTE bond (we have a rental partner on contract).
- Oliver will confirm breaker mapping and whether an alternate feed is available.

I'll keep you posted the minute I hear more. If you want the generator hooked up immediately, confirm and I'll authorize.

Sofia Turner
Event Producer, EventWorks
sofia@eventworks.co

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-09T08:39:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Power & Network outage contingency for AcmeCorp Expo — booth B12

Ben/Sofia —

Checked the panel mapping. Booth B12 is on the south hall A-phase run; we have an alternate B-phase at the adjacent service column but it requires a tap that takes ~30 minutes to install. I attached a quick diagram of the vendor feed and our proposed temporary run (vendor_network_diag.jpg).

Options:
1) Hook up portable generator to B12 now (rental confirmed for 09:45). Pros: immediate isolated power. Cons: manual transfer, short interruption when switching.
2) Tap adjacent feed — slightly cleaner but needs crew and 30–45m.
3) If power is intermittent, we can provision two LTE bonded APs and run demos locally from battery-backed laptops.

I recommend option 1 + LTE APs as a layered approach. I'll stage the crew at 09:15.

Oliver Grant
Venue Operations Manager
Oliver@venueops.com
Attached: vendor_network_diag.jpg

- Marcus: please prepare a local-only demo build + a 5-minute recorded walkthrough that can be played from a laptop if live inference fails. Bring two laptops and the external battery packs. (Due: 09:45)
- Ben: I drafted a one-paragraph customer notification offering a complimentary 1-month credit and the option to move the live session to the afternoon. Please approve before I send to AcmeCorp.
- Stephanie: authorize the generator hookup if Oliver's team confirms it's available (blocking authorization granted).
- Sofia: accept the LTE APs rental and have techs run a quick throughput check post-hookup.

Attachments: floorplan_v3.pdf, signed_sow_acme.pdf

I'll stand by at the booth with Marcus. If the swap causes a 10–15 minute interruption, we'll pivot to the recorded walkthrough immediately to avoid an empty demo slot.

Subject: Re: Urgent: Power & Network outage contingency for AcmeCorp Expo — booth B12

Hi team —

Quick update: venue has identified a temporary power issue in the south hall and is staging a generator at 09:45; they will also bring bonded LTE access as backup. To avoid any interruption to your scheduled demo at 10:00 we plan to:

- Hook the generator and connect bonded LTE APs to the demo laptops.
- If the live model can't access Redwood cloud, we'll run a local demo + a 5-minute recorded walkthrough.
- As a courtesy for the disruption risk, we're offering AcmeCorp a complimentary 1-month Redwood credit and a post-event private demo with our lead solutions engineer.

Please confirm if you prefer we:
A) Proceed as planned (generator + LTE) and keep the 10:00 slot live; or
B) Move your live to 14:00 and run the recorded walkthrough at 10:00.

Apologies for the nuisance — we'll keep the interruption as short as possible.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

Ben/Lauren —

Final update from the electrical contractor: the swap to the alternate feeder was completed overnight and they ran diagnostics this morning. There was a brief brownout window yesterday during the manual change (09:50–10:05) which matches your reports. Generator hookup was staged but not required. Bonded LTE APs were tested and achieved 120/35 Mbps aggregate at the booth location.

We also documented the temporary tap and the breaker label changes; I've attached the final vendor diagram. No further actions required but I've left a tech on call for the remainder of the event.

Oliver
